newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris court validates Alcatel probe.
newsitem.headline: Paris court validates Alcatel probe.

text.p: A Paris appeals court validated on Thursday the major part of an investigation into alleged overbilling by a subsidiary of industrial group Alcatel Alsthom, justice sources said.

The sources said the court deemed legitimate searches carried out in October 1994 in the offices of the subsidiary, telecommunications equipment unit Alcatel CIT. Another court had in May decreed these searches null and void.

But the appeals court, endorsing the earlier court ruling, cancelled the detention in 1995 of Francoise Sampermans, at the time chairwoman of media interests company Generale Occidentale, her questioning and the search at her home.
Investigating magistrate Jean-Marie d'Huy launched the probe in October 1994 to explore widespread alleged overbilling of key client France Telecom.

Forced to resign in 1995, Alcatel Alsthom's former chairman Pierre Suard and about 40 other managers went on trial on Tuesday in a separate case, accused of plundering company funds to pay for work on their private homes.
